# Code Anchors: Story Identity

- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — `isWithdrawnStory`: the exact, case-folded label check and the not-planned/duplicate closure-reason check, either alone sufficing.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.ts` — drops a withdrawn story from the story set and strips any `blocked_by` edge onto it, applied after the sub-issue walk.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/gh.ts` — fetches each sub-issue's `stateReason` alongside its labels and state.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/serialize.ts` — renders every story and sequence-table cell as `#<issue>`; no positional `STORY-<epic>.<seq>` ref is emitted.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.spec.ts`, `resolve.spec.ts`, `serialize.spec.ts` — withdrawal-by-label, withdrawal-by-closure-reason, completed/reopened non-withdrawal, and issue-number-only serialization coverage.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — the `STORY-<epic>.<seq>` ref is confined to the pre-filing batch as an authoring key for wiring `blocked_by`, dead once issues are filed.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/SKILL.md` — documents the `ref` field's batch-local, issue-resolution-only purpose.
- `components/skills/nxs-epic-resolve/SKILL.md` — documents the issue-number-only keying and the withdrawn-story rules (label, closure reason, exact case-folded match, record exemption).
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/wire.ts` — the ported dependency pass: one ref map over this run and the ledger, resolving a batch ref and a literal issue reference by their own rules.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/rewrite.ts` — the ported prose pass: rewrites a surviving ref to its issue number in a body read back from the platform, never re-pushed from the local file.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/rewrite.spec.ts` — coverage for backtick removal, trailing punctuation, case folding, the unmatched bare form, and the unresolved ref left verbatim.
